parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Method 1 — direct favourable cases
${8\choose5}{7\choose0}=56$, ${8\choose4}{7\choose1}=490$, ${8\choose3}{7\choose2}=1176$ [M1]
Guidance: Use ${8\choose x}{7\choose{5-x}}$ for a valid gender split.
${8\choose4}{7\choose1}=490$ or ${8\choose3}{7\choose2}=1176$ [B1]
Guidance: A correct identified count for $4M1W$ or $3M2W$ earns the independent mark.
$56+490+1176$ [M1]
Guidance: Add exactly the three favourable splits, with no invalid or repeated case; accept unsimplified.
$1722$ [A1]
Guidance: Final value $1722$ with no wrong working.
Method 2 — complement
${8\choose2}{7\choose3}=980$, ${8\choose1}{7\choose4}=280$, ${8\choose0}{7\choose5}=21$ [M1]
Guidance: Use ${8\choose x}{7\choose{5-x}}$ for a valid unfavourable gender split.
${8\choose2}{7\choose3}=980$ or ${8\choose1}{7\choose4}=280$ [B1]
Guidance: A correct identified count for $2M3W$ or $1M4W$ earns the independent mark.
${15\choose5}-(980+280+21)=3003-(980+280+21)$ [M1]
Guidance: Subtract exactly the three unfavourable splits from an identified total of all five-person committees; accept unsimplified.
$1722$ [A1]
Guidance: Final value $1722$ with no wrong working.
Total: 4

Guidance: Begin with a combination choosing one group of size 3, 5 or 7, multiplied by a further positive count.
${15\choose3}{12\choose5}{7\choose7}=455\times792$ [M1]
Guidance: Use successive choices ${15\choose s}{15-s\choose t}{15-s-t\choose u}$ for distinct $s,t,u\in\{3,5,7\}$.
$360360$ [A1]

parts.label: (c)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Method 1 — subtract arrangements with both pairs together
$6!\times2-5!\times2\times2$ [M1]
Guidance: Count Abel–Betty as a block with its two internal orders and subtract a positive count for the forbidden Freya–Gino adjacency.
$1440-480$ [M1]
Guidance: Show either $6!\times2-c$ with $1<c<1440$, or $d-5!\times2\times2$ with $d>1440$.
$960$ [A1]
Guidance: Final answer $960$.
Method 2 — arrange F and G separately
$2\times4!\times5\times4$ [M1]
Guidance: Arrange Abel–Betty as a block and the other four separating people, giving $2\times4!$ times a positive factor.
$2\times4!\times5\times4$ [M1]
Guidance: Place Freya and Gino in two distinct gaps, giving a factor $5\times4$; condone an equivalent ordered-gap count.
$960$ [A1]
Guidance: Final answer $960$.
Total: 3
